metaDescription: Order custom recycled cables & cords for eco-friendly branding. Perfect for trade shows and corporate gifts. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Recycled cables and cords let you offer a practical charging solution while reinforcing your company's commitment to sustainability. Made from post-consumer recycled materials, these accessories pair well with eco-conscious marketing campaigns or green workplace initiatives. Options like the Xoopar OctoMini Charging Cable combine compact portability with recycled construction, making them ideal for trade show giveaways or employee welcome kits. Choose from multiple connector types and add your logo via pad printing or laser engraving.
heroAltText: Custom recycled cables and cords with printed logos displayed on a desk, including a coiled charging cable and a ring light cable.
